join_order.notes: Precompute is_promo[partkey] bool array; O(1) lookup per qualifying lineitem row via part_p_partkey_lookup index

data_structures.promo_lookup: bool_array(2000001) indexed by partkey — precomputed from p_type dict codes starting with PROMO
data_structures.zonemap: block min/max array for l_shipdate — skip blocks where max < 9374 || min >= 9404
data_structures.aggregation: two thread-local double accumulators (promo_sum, total_sum) per thread, reduced after parallel scan

parallelism.notes: Parallel scan over qualifying blocks only; each thread accumulates local promo_sum and total_sum, then atomically reduce

indexes.notes: Map partkey → row_id to read p_type for each part; used only during is_promo precomputation

phase1_build_promo: Load p_type_dict.bin: read uint32_t count, then for each entry read uint16_t len + char[len]
Build set of dict codes where string starts with 'PROMO'
Allocate bool is_promo[max_partkey+1] initialized to false
For each part row: read p_partkey and p_type code, set is_promo[partkey] = (code in promo_set)
phase2_zonemap_prefilter: Build qualifying_blocks vector: include block if !(max < 9374 || min >= 9404)
